item.title: NRG Energy — Q3 2026 Results
item.description: Official NRG Energy, Inc. (NYSE: NRG) conference call reviewing results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Per the company's release: GAAP net income of $561 million, Adjusted EPS of $4.68, Adjusted EBITDA of $2,013 million and free cash flow before growth investments of $1,242 million; 2026 guidance reaffirmed, 2027 guidance initiated, and a $4 billion agreement to sell 4.9 GW of natural gas-fired generation to LS Power.

item.title: Vistra — Q3 2026 Results
item.description: Official Vistra Corp. (NYSE: VST) webcast reviewing third quarter 2026 results. Per the company's release: GAAP net income of $1,140 million, Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA up more than 50% year over year to $2,378 million, 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance narrowed to $7.1–$7.5 billion, 2027 guidance initiated at $7.7–$8.5 billion, an additional $1.5 billion share repurchase authorization, and the October close of the roughly 5,500 MW Cogentrix Energy acquisition.
